# SEO-116: List sitemap URLs on the same host that serves the sitemap

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

## Statement

Entries name URLs on the host from which the sitemap was fetched, unless the sitemap is a cross-submission that the receiving platform has been told to accept for the other host.

## Rationale

The protocol scopes a sitemap to the location it is served from, so entries for another host fall outside that scope and are ignored rather than merely deprioritised.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ],
  "any": [
    "has_sitemap"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Build entry URLs from the same configured origin the canonical uses, so a deployment serving several hosts produces a separate file per host. In a monorepo, generate one sitemap per deployed application rather than one combined file.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Compare the host of every entry against the host that served the containing sitemap and list the mismatches.
- Evidence: `SITEMAP`, `HTTP_STATUS`, `ROUTE`
- Automated check: `sitemap-loc-same-host`

## Scope

- Search surfaces: `GOOGLE_SEARCH`, `BING_SEARCH`
- Frameworks: `any`
- Caution: none recorded.
